Copy `S16_1280.GEO` from the previously supplied `Basebox-SVGA-Ensemble12(2).zip`:

`source/pm-backport/target-original/GWSVGA/SYSTEM/S16_1280.GEO`

Expected SHA-256:
`5c56db2b0c39ac66e7448a672a68c8722876b547c7822a006cd31da26f98654d`
